notes: ODL-933 (t_fda54dd4): the tenant backup over the BX11. scripts/backup.py now asks restic for two SFTP connections (-o sftp.connections=2, five runs = the box's published ten), puts -p 22 in sftp.command because the colon form has no port field and refuses one by name, reads the repository before the upload and again after the prune against BACKUP_TENANT_CAP_BYTES (default 2,000,000,000) and writes status: over_cap with the size (a run that starts over the cap uploads nothing), and renders the timer from the slug (02:00 UTC + int(sha256(slug)[:2], 16) % 240, RandomizedDelaySec=0, Persistent=true). The backup service carries ConditionPathExists=/etc/odile/recovery.txt, and the installer's ensure_recovery mints no password on a rebuild until the user's paste exists. The installer writes /etc/odile/backup-repo.txt, /etc/odile/backup-ssh/id_ed25519 (0600) and known_hosts from the seed, and no backup-s3.env. This cut is 2026.11.26-1 over main's 2026.11.25-1: installer_sha256, backup_sha256, the manifest and this document's hashes move; no skill, page or template changed.
